programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 幾區夾公仔店的監控片段，都拍到兩人團夥毫不掩飾樣貌公然爆竊，十分猖獗。中環某天橋樓梯長期被外傭霸佔，還化身為山寨美容院，更疑似以低價為其他外傭提供按摩、修甲等服務？除了中環外，荃灣亦有類似情況？大律師指出涉事者或已違反在港逗留條件，還有阻街、妨擾罪行。陳豪、陳貝兒、譚俊彥等星級藝員出席TVB推廣營銷平台發佈會，並分享理財投資心得。另帶來有助擺脫濕敏困擾的相關資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2763粵
programme.desc: 壯、Elaine與Venus被力蓮抽中，負責籌辦春茗。壯與Venus本想偷懶，打算沿用往年流程，Elaine卻用心構思新項目，獲力蓮讚賞；因Elaine過於投入，壯與Venus亦被迫加倍努力，因此疲於奔命。壯嘗試勸Elaine不要太落力，卻不果。Venus暗中「搞破壞」，Elaine意外識破此事，並得知壯亦不認同自己……春茗當天，眾人期待享用佳餚、抽獲名貴禮品，以及欣賞巨星演出，但卻大失所望……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#15粵PG
programme.desc: 妙姿先宗南一步前往奕風家，處理了可證明奕風協助學年逃脫的物品。步青往找佳琪，請求她幫忙調查奕風。學年被踢出四聯商會，劉彪重返四聯，並接管車仔化工的業務。學年跟蹤劉彪、索帕，發現奕風與索帕會面。學年綁走奕風，當得知奕風是助世豪對付劉彪，表示可提供協助。佳琪發現劉彪和麗荃的曖昧行徑，終證實二人偷情。妙姿拿到嘉盈的電腦，找小茹幫忙解碼；其後，電腦卻出現在奕風手上……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 瑾瑜醉酒說心口疼，令楚楚想到什麼，複驗神觀屍體後發現他是中毒而亡。景翊府中遭賊，冷月推測賊人是為花而來，眾人分析後鎖定森垚。景翊把森垚帶到瑾瑜面前套話，森垚終說出是聽從鬼差的話，給神觀喝了下了藥的茶。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：攻你上大學粵
programme.desc: 中三考題開正《中年好聲音》眾人的「音樂專業」，有人豪言答錯即引退！「褶曲作用」的地貌考起大家，文靜老師更畀山埃貼士？中五公民與社會發展題，某君趣談「軟硬理論」，令Bob教授都難以招架！大學領域難度升級，「優異生」二話不說將滴定管題目送給對手。模仿有助解讀接吻魚行為？終極兩強以物理學「重力奇異點」知識對決，被「欽點」答題者卻分析得似層層，可望轉危為機。音樂巨作成贏「獎學金」關卡，哼得出都未必識答……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#23粵
programme.desc: 趙穆宴請董匡，突指他是冒牌貨，少龍嚇一跳。琴清與少龍在花園相遇，少龍放出捉來的螢火蟲，無數螢火蟲圍著琴清飛舞令她驚歎。趙穆秘密去祭山鬼，少龍計劃利用一線天的天險生擒趙穆。琴清邀少龍遊湖畫畫，少龍靈機一動將琴清的水墨畫改為彩墨畫，琴清喜出望外。回程時琴清扭傷腳，由少龍抱回府。滕翼責少龍錯過生擒趙穆的機會，少龍愧疚。琴清再約少龍遊湖，卻驚見趙穆出現，卻被幪面黑衣人偷襲就擒，琴清扯下黑衣人面巾及假鬍子。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 幾區夾公仔店的監控片段，都拍到兩人團夥毫不掩飾樣貌公然爆竊，十分猖獗。中環某天橋樓梯長期被外傭霸佔，還化身為山寨美容院，更疑似以低價為其他外傭提供按摩、修甲等服務？除了中環外，荃灣亦有類似情況？大律師指出涉事者或已違反在港逗留條件，還有阻街、妨擾罪行。陳豪、陳貝兒、譚俊彥等星級藝員出席TVB推廣營銷平台發佈會，並分享理財投資心得。另帶來有助擺脫濕敏困擾的相關資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 女性於更年期後因雌激素下降，患心血管疾病的風險大增。心臟科醫生指男女的心臟病發的症狀大有分別，女士如出現上背痛、上腹痛便要提高警覺。通波仔手術是心臟病的主流治療，部份女患者卻未必適合，有何原因？區瑞強、周國豐、鄭子誠三位資深DJ將首次合作開騷，他們惺惺相惜，私下情誼深厚。國豐笑言擔心唱歌時忘記歌詞；子誠亦坦言對唱歌感憂慮，並感謝區瑞強的窩心支援。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「魚香茄子肉碎」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 有沒有一家店可一次過品嚐東莞各地區的美食？在萬江區，本集探店的這家酒樓就可以滿足你，不僅如此，內裡還附設一個甚具規模的東莞飲食風俗博物館！大飽口福之後，祖藍還帶大家去「料」(玩)，行逛一個歷史文化古村— 下壩坊，這裡並不簡單，遊人於白天可以感受百年古鎮的風情，夜晚就大變身，成為年輕人最愛「蒲」之地……

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#5粵
programme.desc: 兆明請員工吃蛋撻，威龍替他說好話，秀瓊詫異。兆明約司徒嵐參加莎莎舞之夜；竇彰亦答應德正一同參加莎莎舞活動。司徒嵐在舞會忽見秀瓊出現，她要兆明迴避。德正與柯美娜跳舞期間見到秀瓊，即找兆明掩飾。六人同坐一桌，司徒嵐苦思如何收拾殘局。秀瓊前往拜祭亡夫，司徒嵐要秀瓊憶述父親救人犧牲經過。俊男向司徒嵐送花示愛，司徒嵐表示已有男朋友，竇彰誤會司徒嵐認定自己是其男友。威龍等車時見到曉盈喝醉，鄧勤送她回家……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#53粵
programme.desc: 佐敦與麗鬧翻，亨回印度的事不了了之。亨向麗勒索，更令人誤會二人拍拖。麗向亨表示凡知道她富有的人三日內必定會意外死去，亨接連遇上怪事，往找麗求救。麗道出唯有說服其他人相信這個秘密，從而將詛咒轉移給那人。

programme.title: 天龍八部#26粵普PG
programme.desc: 虛竹回少林寺，靈鷲宮四姑娘暗中跟隨。哲羅星與清涼寺方丈來到少林寺，要求少林寺釋放波羅星。少林寺則指波羅星偷學少林武功。期間鳩摩智前來挑戰少林眾長老，虛竹見狀還擊，卻暴露了自己身上的逍遙派武功…

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一集，大媽們在社區會堂跳着熟練舞步，對寵物、表演、食物相關歇後語又有多少認識？俗語「豆泥」源自糕點餡料；「蘇蝦仔」正寫是「蘇孲崽」，大學講師廖舜禧逐一解構。三位主持和黃建東在懷舊士多「尋寶」，竟分別互稱表兄妹，究竟搞邊科？「摩羅街雨褸－ 過底」有何喻意？掌故專家鄭寶鴻並講解摩羅街叫摩羅街的原因。主持們走進果欄了解「發財丁」、「坐車」等行內術語；還向毛冷舖店主請教不同毛冷的質地及保存毛衣方法。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 傳統金器手工精巧，現代機器難以取代。主持人來到金舖欣賞各款名貴首飾，期間竟有人被稱呼為「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮製，昔日風味得以保存。麥美恩親自拜師學習做糖，順道細談「石地板種花生」、「發霉花生」等歇後語。「老細」、「事頭」何以成為上司代名詞？且聽中文講師廖舜禧拆解。粵語逾二千年來原來甚少演變，故被視為古漢語「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯廣府話歷史，還從「錫」「勼」「冧」三字解構愛情真義！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本集將介紹沙特阿拉伯一種獨特的編織工藝- 「阿爾薩度」貝都因人用阿爾薩度親手為家庭製作所需的物品, 她們一邊編織布料, 一邊互相分享家人的消息, 阿爾薩度不只是織布技術, 更是一種團結家庭的集體藝術

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 敏之、凱琳正享用豐富早餐之際，高Ling忽然帶同楊明神秘回歸，為姊妹送上驚喜！走進地道市場，四人兵分兩路，盡情選購特色小食、用品。敏之、凱琳化身「頭巾西施」推銷商品，反應理想！楊明、高Ling緊接接受挑戰，更出動「美男計」兜售頭巾，生意又怎樣？一行人登船前往停泊島，迎接陽光與海灘。當地度假村設有不同類型的酒店房間，三位美女藉小遊戲分房期間卻與製作團隊發生衝突……楊明細看之下，竟察覺當中有蠱惑？

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: Ben Sir帶隊，聯同祖儀、衍峰向上水古洞村出發，來到村內碩果僅存的舊式茶樓，桌上碌鵝、釀鯪魚等菜餚，品嚐傳統客家風味。三人緊接前往馬草壟迎接醉人日落，捕捉靚人靚景，輕鬆完成打卡之旅！衍峰、鄺潔楹隨蕭欣浩博士尋找舊香港足跡，暢遊上環歌賦街，享用港式美食，霸王鴨、金錢雞有何來頭？穎彤、黃庭鋒實試幾款設備齊全的本地露營車，還可觀星、煮飯仔，適合二人世界。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 荷里活電影被譽為業界殿堂，其歷史可追溯至一百多年前。瀅仴簡介最早期的默片，以及有聲與彩色電影的誕生過程。上世紀約七十年代被指是傳統與新荷里活電影的分水嶺，二者有何不同？來到千禧年，電影走進數碼時代，另一谷主凱婷覺得電腦合成影像(CG)是最大特色。瀅仴引述「派拉蒙法案」案例，它是影響上世紀美國影業發展的重大事件。踏入廿一世紀，串流平台興起，也導致影業的生態再有大轉變。此外，據說電影彩蛋與復活節有關？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 巴打秘景遊粵
programme.desc: 置身遠離繁囂的荔枝窩，「巴打」在生態導師帶領下夜探郊野，上一堂大自然生態課。預定到海岸邊賞日出，陳浚霆卻「唔知醒」，拍檔們決定大整蠱！歎杯金針花茶後，三人初試下田施肥與耘田，有人「泥足深陷」，焦浩軒更把工具弄斷？他們還獲居民設宴招待，品嚐家常客家菜。鴨洲可以找到罕見的褐紅色沉積岩，「鴨頸」、「鴨眼」更是必到打卡點！緊接到訪鄰近小島吉澳，巴打入鄉隨俗，體驗釣魚之餘，也會學做客家茶粿，感受純樸人情味。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 東南亞食品向來深受香港人歡迎，本集Gigi姐就會教大家做一道充滿東南亞風味的豬頸肉，而帶出這種風味的秘訣在於磨碎了的檸檬葉、魚露、青檸汁和辣椒粉。只要掌握上述竅門，就能很簡單做出美味的豬頸肉。

programme.title: 好市民獎頒獎典禮2025粵
programme.desc: 「好巿民奬」旨在彰顯好人好事，帶動社會守望相助、攜手撲滅罪行。2025年度頒奬典禮於2026年3月14日在會展舉行，並由區永權、陳庭欣擔任司儀，凝聚好市民、好機構的正能量。各個獲獎單位為協助警方破案、拯救生命、推動防罪滅罪作傑出貢獻，TVB直播嘉許情況。單立文、張馳豪、周志康、鄭俊弘、羅毓儀藉歌聲鼓勵一眾無名英雄；男團Hey Brother獻唱之餘，還與林秀怡合演小劇場，宣揚好市民精神與防騙訊息。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，這次兩項訓練都集中於下身，聽從兒童體適能教練的指示來完成吧！跟隨拍子做運動，提起一隻腳上下移動的同時，分別將一隻手以鐘擺形式擺動，以及舉高、放低雙手，可有難度？站立式的「踏單車」動作，有助增強下肢肌力與協調度。輪到「臀部訓練」，以不同姿勢坐於瑜伽墊上，利用臀部發力做鍛練，亦可順道伸展腰部。雙手帶動身體向後仰的動作，既可伸展頸部與胸大肌，練習得多就更易做到拱橋？

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 白色情人節將至，小丸子期盼豐厚回禮，冬田和小渚亦各自對心儀的男孩有所期待。小丸子從花輪口中得知古董的價值，於是偕同爺爺去逛廢物市集，希望發掘到不為人知的寶物，藉此發一筆橫財。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 衞生署兒童體能智力測驗中心，大約有七成新症在服務目標的6個月內完成評估，但部分個案聲稱要輪候年半至兩年。輪候時間長，萬一兒童錯過六歲前的「黃金介入期」，對他們成長有多大影響呢？隨著社會對特殊教育需要的認識和接受程度提升，預計懷疑個案會越來越多，政府可以如何加強服務，讓這批小朋友及早獲得評估及適切的治療呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: K Cash業主私人貸款呈獻 :香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 祥師兄所說全港最美味的墨魚丸，是怎樣製造的？粉麵店第三代傳人指重點是新鮮，豬肉丸亦是同樣道理！店主偕同母親傳承祖傳的味道，目標成為百年老店！婚禮攝影師銳意打造屬於年輕人的新派旗袍，還提供化妝、攝影一條龍服務。祥師兄穿起店內唐裝，再於街頭拍照，大讚專業！灣仔一間小木屋其實是鬆餅小店，開店源於吃過英國鬆餅，但發覺在港難找到？小店也可發展為大公司，祥師兄走訪本地個人護理用品廠房，CEO亦會細說經營理念。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！兩孩之母Mani繼續衝擊第二條提款線，更劍指「魔王之歌」？每年自資到錄音室錄歌的歌唱愛好者亦會接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: 吳崇銘發覺布志綸作品<如是因 如是果與自己的<掛念你 你好嗎構思相若，於是帶來「一晚限定」的混唱合作，兩人亦分別送上甜蜜情歌<一家之主與<貼地，志綸還有忠粉到場支持偶像。張馳豪新推出<一個人的生日歌，旨在為孤單人士送上力量。獨立歌手Young Hysan唱出他的<道歉啟示。馮熙燮細談獨立組合時期與現時成為簽約歌手的大不同，並感謝T-Rexx將其心路歷程，寫進<聆聽自己的聲音歌詞內。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 藍蟹是梭子蟹的分支，美國馬里蘭人愛蒸熟後撒上當地香料，味道鹹香辛辣。日本廚師是拆蟹達人，能將香箱蟹拆肉後再拼回原隻奉客。美國人則喜歡將蟹拆肉，混合麵包糠、蛋黃醬等造蟹餅，酥香可口。螃蟹脫殼後，會暫時變為肉少的水蟹，澳門人看準其特性，煮成水蟹粥，鮮甜滋味。江蘇一帶會將蟛蜞搗碎過濾煮成「豆腐」，軟滑鮮香。將生蟹加鹽醃製的熗蟹，是浙江的地道美食。韓國人亦擅於將生蟹醃製進食，醬油蟹更被喻為「白飯小偷」。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 四位香港傑出學生運動員獎得主細談感受與目標，又會如何平衡學業與體育？U18男子冰球世錦賽，港隊在尾場挫新西蘭，以四勝一負成績摘亞。曼聯舊將朗尼莊臣來港參與足球活動，與小朋友交流，並回望「紅魔」歲月。甲一籃球總決賽第三場，滿貫與香港東方爭逐領先優勢。王瑋駿、陳鈺文於維港賽艇賽奪雙人雙槳艇金牌；另檢視香港田徑系列賽男、女飛人衝線時刻。這集還帶來學界足球精英賽兩場準決賽戰報、青少年棍網球公開賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 本地出生率持續創新低，但去年嬰幼兒用品零售市場，反而逆市造好，為何會如此？中東局勢緊張，一旦情況進一步惡化，對全球以至香港經濟的影響多大？

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#7粵PG
programme.desc: 諾召開記者會為公司醜聞致歉；晨到總公司履新，接到雄的來電。證物房起火，USB被燒毀，同時證人發亦被殺。KC以曦偽造文件的影片威脅晨助其加入總公司，結果反遭晨威脅。雄約晨見面，讓晨在諾的辦公室裝監聽器。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: Ben Sir帶隊，聯同祖儀、衍峰向上水古洞村出發，來到村內碩果僅存的舊式茶樓，桌上碌鵝、釀鯪魚等菜餚，品嚐傳統客家風味。三人緊接前往馬草壟迎接醉人日落，捕捉靚人靚景，輕鬆完成打卡之旅！衍峰、鄺潔楹隨蕭欣浩博士尋找舊香港足跡，暢遊上環歌賦街，享用港式美食，霸王鴨、金錢雞有何來頭？穎彤、黃庭鋒實試幾款設備齊全的本地露營車，還可觀星、煮飯仔，適合二人世界。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 荷里活電影被譽為業界殿堂，其歷史可追溯至一百多年前。瀅仴簡介最早期的默片，以及有聲與彩色電影的誕生過程。上世紀約七十年代被指是傳統與新荷里活電影的分水嶺，二者有何不同？來到千禧年，電影走進數碼時代，另一谷主凱婷覺得電腦合成影像(CG)是最大特色。瀅仴引述「派拉蒙法案」案例，它是影響上世紀美國影業發展的重大事件。踏入廿一世紀，串流平台興起，也導致影業的生態再有大轉變。此外，據說電影彩蛋與復活節有關？

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 敏之、凱琳正享用豐富早餐之際，高Ling忽然帶同楊明神秘回歸，為姊妹送上驚喜！走進地道市場，四人兵分兩路，盡情選購特色小食、用品。敏之、凱琳化身「頭巾西施」推銷商品，反應理想！楊明、高Ling緊接接受挑戰，更出動「美男計」兜售頭巾，生意又怎樣？一行人登船前往停泊島，迎接陽光與海灘。當地度假村設有不同類型的酒店房間，三位美女藉小遊戲分房期間卻與製作團隊發生衝突……楊明細看之下，竟察覺當中有蠱惑？

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 香港近年成為全球最長壽地區，幾位十歲出頭的孩子又希望活到多少歲？在節目組和洪永城安排下，小朋友分成兩組，第一組到學校，向校長及負責老師了解校內如何推行生死教育，並共同飼養一條「寵物魚」。第二組前往山野接受求生技巧訓練，掌握搭建帳篷後，一試野外捉魚並隨即動刀劏魚。活動尾聲，兩組人都有一條魚作「食物報酬」，為何一邊感到雀躍，另一邊卻愁雲慘霧？養魚組別當知道眼前蒸魚並非所養的寵物魚，心情和胃口大為轉變！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本集將介紹沙特阿拉伯一種獨特的編織工藝- 「阿爾薩度」貝都因人用阿爾薩度親手為家庭製作所需的物品, 她們一邊編織布料, 一邊互相分享家人的消息, 阿爾薩度不只是織布技術, 更是一種團結家庭的集體藝術

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 韓國小姐(完)
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 衝吧！小鐵人
programme.desc: 10位來自不同背景的孩子們，他們將一起挑戰小鐵人比賽，經歷90天的長征，與2160個小時的訓練，彼此互相扶持與鼓勵，用開闊與豁達突破自我、挑戰極限，成為獨立又自信的小大人。他們的目標不僅是完成這項超越大人的任務，更是向世界證明自己的實力與決心。

programme.title: 豆小鴨神奇小分隊(完)
programme.desc: 單純直率的豆小鴨總是不小心闖禍，還好他有最棒的好朋友－－善解人意的袋熊沃蓓，和熱愛發明的小豬奇姆！只要三個人在一起，不管遇到任何困難，都能運用創意找到有趣的方法解決，把日常生活的所有危機，變成精彩好玩的大冒險！快快快，一起來山谷洞玩吧！

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 豆小鴨神奇小分隊(完)
programme.desc: 單純直率的豆小鴨總是不小心闖禍，還好他有最棒的好朋友－－善解人意的袋熊沃蓓，和熱愛發明的小豬奇姆！只要三個人在一起，不管遇到任何困難，都能運用創意找到有趣的方法解決，把日常生活的所有危機，變成精彩好玩的大冒險！快快快，一起來山谷洞玩吧！

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 魔法小廚師
programme.desc: 魔法小廚師小令、茲普、史黛拉和陽陽，利用特魯莉奶奶的魔法食譜，享受烹飪、盡情冒險，每個食譜都充滿驚喜、風味和色彩，但大鬍子庫伯卻想偷走這本食譜！

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 時光之城(完)
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Making Friends Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are off for a Jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Everglades National Park, Florida
programme.desc: The Go Jetters save the Florida Everglades when hungry alligators chase Glitch's picnic.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits theatre, it's the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Cucumber
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits theatre, it's Cucumber performing Cool Under Pressure while trying to not let any obstacle ruin her calm routine.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - The Good, the Bad and the Prickly
programme.desc: Prickly Pear arrives in the Supermarket and tries to take over Evil Pea's freezer. Supertato discovers that Prickly Pear isn't mean at all and just needed some good friends.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - The Great Book Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the books from the Supermarket. Supertato, Chilli and Carrot try to rescue all the books by using acrobatic skills they learnt from their favourite circus book.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Give It Back
programme.desc: Tinky Winky and Dipsy both want a go with Tinky Winky's bag and start to squabble. The Noo-­‐noo sucks up the bag and only gives it back when Tinky Winky and Dipsy are ready to share.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - Tubby Custard and Toast
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing about the wonders of Tubby Custard and Toast.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - The First Big Camping Adventure
programme.desc: The friends are excited to go on a camping trip, but Zip is nervous about being in a dark place away from home. He must try to overcome his fears.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Yeti
programme.desc: Dog and Pug are trying to solve one of the world's great mysteries, and they meet Granny Pug trying to track down the Yeti.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Messy-morphosis
programme.desc: Messy monster can't find his caterpillar friends. The garden bush where he left his friends is now covered with pretty butterflies. But where did the caterpillars go? He flutters off to OKIDO to find out.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Thirsty Robot
programme.desc: Messy monster can't work out why his cart won't move. The wheels just won't go round like normal. Off he goes to OKIDO to find out why.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Cheesy Bang Bang
programme.desc: The cheese delivery race is on as Mojo and the racer top try to deliver food faster than Filo. But the competition gets too hot when an explosive souffle is on the table!

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to find a butterfly
programme.desc: JoJo searches for a butterfly to complete her nature tick-book. She learns that all butterflies start life as furry little caterpillars.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S1) - It's time for a spring clear out
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are having a spring clear out, but when Gran Gran wants to clear out her old jumper, JoJo is distraught - she loves that snuggly jumper!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Basking Shark
programme.desc: Sarah is keen to adopt a sea creature, but doesn't get her first choice...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Old Toys
programme.desc: Duck is bored of his toy collection, so he and Sarah search for old toys in the attic.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S24) - Cleo the Road Engine
programme.desc: Inventor Ruth has a new steam powered car to try out. But Cleo the car is headstrong and when Thomas challenges her to a race she takes some risks to guarantee a win.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bike
programme.desc: Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bob Bilby
programme.desc: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to show him a good time.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Spy Game
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game, their grown-up controlling device stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Aargh! Jelly!

programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels hop inside the Biology Bus and miniaturize themselves.

programme.desc: Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters attempt to climb the Matterhorn.

programme.desc: Xuli and Glitch go head to head as they try to beat the Go Jet Academy land speed record.

programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stuck
programme.desc: All of the Teletubbies are stuck. Tinky Winky's hand is stuck in the bag, Dipsy's hat is stuck, Laa-Laa's ball is stuck and Po is stuck on the Tubby Slidey!

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - I Can Be Anything
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and follow their dreams.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - The Friendship Parade
programme.desc: Plom, Phoebe, Mae-Mae, Hooper, Zip, and Fly are a group of unique paper friends who live in Pop Paper City. They find new ways to have fun, such as playing pirates, building theme parks and even exploring outer space.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Art
programme.desc: Pug wants to learn how to paint. Our heroes visit Picasso's studio in Paris.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Thirsty Robot
programme.desc: Messy monster can't work out why his cart won't move. The wheels just won't go round like normal. Off he goes to OKIDO to find out why.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Mr Kite Takes Flight
programme.desc: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy monster is just about to take a bite out of his delicious green sock for breakfast, but before he can it gets blown away! He goes to OKIDO to find out why the wind is so blowy.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to bake
programme.desc: Gran Gran and JoJo are excited to bake a batch of Great Gran Gran's signature Saint Lucian banana bread, but there's a problem - they don't know how long to bake it for!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to find a butterfly
programme.desc: JoJo searches for a butterfly to complete her nature tick-book. She learns that all butterflies start life as furry little caterpillars.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Old Toys
programme.desc: Duck is bored of his toy collection, so he and Sarah search for old toys in the attic.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Hair Cut
programme.desc: Sarah's hair keeps getting in her way, so it's time for a trip to the hairdressers.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Nia's Bright Idea
programme.desc: Nia uses what she learns about lighthouses to suggest covering a big wheel in Christmas lights, so that Harold can see where he's going in a storm.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bob Bilby
programme.desc: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to show him a good time.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Spy Game
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game, their grown-up controlling device stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Takeaway
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Veggie Magic
programme.desc: When Evil Pea poses as a magician so that she can use tricks to make the Tato Team 'disappear', Supertato and Carrot create their own magical plan to rescue them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Biology Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels hop inside the Biology Bus and miniaturize themselves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Puddle Badge
programme.desc: Happy sets his sights on a questionable looking puddle that he is determined to splash in!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Matterhorn, Italy and Switzerland
programme.desc: Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters attempt to climb the Matterhorn.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bonneville Salt Flats, USA
programme.desc: Xuli and Glitch go head to head as they try to beat the Go Jet Academy land speed record.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: Can the Go Jetters save the world's stinkiest plant from becoming Glitch's latest perfume?

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S1) - Orson's English Bakewell Tart
programme.desc: Orson is cooking his special version of Bakewell tart. To make things more exciting, he is throwing his friends an afternoon tea party with fancy dress. This is going to be fun!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Dusky Leaf Monkey
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Malaysia, South East Asia on a baby animal mission to find out why new born dusky leaf monkeys look so different to their parents.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S8) - Boom Family Reunion
programme.desc: In this episode Seaweed is missing his family, so Sandy organises a 'Boom' video call with his (and Captain Captain's) unusual relatives.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Krash's New Friend
programme.desc: A beam of light sweeps through the window. Krash finds a glowing ball bouncing in the shop

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shaun
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a pet. To show them how much work they'd be in for, Dad gets to transform his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu with a taste for trouble.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Daddy Putdown
programme.desc: When Mum goes out to a baby shower, Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine. But with Bluey missing Mum, Dad has to pull out all the games he knows to keep them entertained.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Dance Mode
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in "Dance Mode" as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Waltzing Potato
programme.desc: Evil Pea plans to freeze Supertato into an ice cube by pretending to teach him to dance.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught between an anti-Ching Confederation and violent, vengeful Ching troops.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - The Eternal Knight Pt. 2
programme.desc: To end the Eternal Night, Jim and the Trollhuntersmust risk everything in their battle against Gunmar.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Escape From The Darklands
programme.desc: Toby, Claire, and Blinky work to keep the human world unaware of Jim’s absence as they look for ways to rescue him from the Darklands

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - The Black Paladin
programme.desc: Voltron charges toward Zarkon's massive ship. When Shiro loses control of the Black Lion, the team must figure out a new way to defeat the Galra.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Across The Universe
programme.desc: Team Voltron is left scattered with Shiro and Keith on a lava planet, Pidge stranded on a garbage nebula, and Coran and Allura trapped in a wormhole

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Cowboy Next Door
programme.desc: When the annual roundup and town dance brings cowboy Javier to Miradero Lucky finds a new friend who can teach her and Spirit a new trick.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Rhino Charges
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Rhino didn't charge and he couldn't see very well at all. Poor old Rhino really wanted to be invited to the Dance of the Horns up on the plains with Buffalo and all the other horned animals. But Rhino didn't have a horn, so he wasn't allowed. The Monkeys decide to help Rhino and make him a horn from a piece of old wood. But when Rhino wakes up he doesn't know what it is. ‘Aargh! Thing on the end of my nose! CHAAaarge!' And that's Why Rhino Charges.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Caterpillar Is Never In A Hurry
programme.desc: You see Caterpillar was never in a hurry. When all the animals were racing around Tinga Tinga getting ready for the Best-dressed parade, Caterpillar was happy to sit in a tree and munch on leaves saying ‘Po-le, po-le, slowly, slowly, good things come to those who wait'. Then one day the rains come and Caterpillar disappears into a cocoon. ‘What's happening?' questions Elephant. ‘Wait and see' says Tortoise wisely ‘Wait and See'.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Horse Powered Dinkie
programme.desc: Farmer Green tells the cars about olden days, when the only transport was horse and cart. Maxi and Drifter say they would never be seen travelling that slow… or would they?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - FB's Sleepover
programme.desc: FB is excited about his sleepover with the other cars in the workshop but when the night draws in he is unsure of his unfamiliar surroundings. Big Chris helps set him at his ease

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cici Spectacular
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has asked CiCi to perform one of her stunts in front of a big crowd. CiCi is very nervous and Roary does his best to help his friend prepare for the event.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cry Cold
programme.desc: Big Chris is feeling ill so Marsha sends him to bed until he is better. Big Chris enjoys the attention rather too much and fails to let everyone know when he is on the mend.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Marsha Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Marsha overhears the others saying she is too bossy. She decides that Silver hatch would be a better place without her. Chaos swiftly ensues, can Marsha be persuaded to stay, they can't cope without her!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Let's Hear It For Big Chris
programme.desc: Big Chris is working on Loada while the others plan a surprise evening for him for being the longest serving member of Silver hatch

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Furious Fun
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders have a "Dragon Day" to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - That's Sooo Rob
programme.desc: Julien’s former BFF, Rob, returns to lure the king away from his royal responsibilities and back to his crazy partying days.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - The Man In The Iron Booty
programme.desc: King Julien sends his entire kingdom away on rafts to help an alleged fellow king who is supposedly in distress.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Poompf!

As Crispin expands his plan to burst all the plush toys in the neighborhood, Tina discovers she can stop this by breaking open and rewiring a single toy doll. Unfortunately that doll is Baby Corp’s current head honcho, Pull-String CEO Baby.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Flamingo Stands On One Leg
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Flamingo stood on both legs. One morning, Flamingo and her flock landed at the Water Hole when all the crabs were busy performing their underwater dance. Needless to say, all these legs where in their way! Tortoise came up with the plan that if all Crabs each nipped a flamingo leg, there will be room to share the waterhole. So from then on, Flamingo stood on one legs and Crabs were able to perform their dance in the watering hole

programme.title: The King Of Snooker - EP4
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP14
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP24
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP10
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon - EP10
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins.

programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP3

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP2
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). programme.title: 2026 New Taipei City Wan Jin Shi Marathon
programme.desc: The 2026 New Taipei City Wan Jin Shi Marathon will take place on March 15! As Taiwan's first road race to earn the World Athletics "Gold Label" certification, this event starts from Wanli and winds along the breathtaking North Coast toward Jinshan. Combining stunning ocean views with challenging terrain, it is hailed by runners as "Taiwan's Most Beautiful Coastal Marathon.
